profile.Name: Bastard King
profile.Personality: Little is known of him beyond his gang's appetite for easy plunder: the Bastards pick fights with foes already weakened and strip battlefields that others have won.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Bastards from Bastion Overlook in Bast, and a large bounty hangs on his head. His upstart bandits grew rich on the chaos of the wars in Bast, work to foil any major Holy Nation or United Cities advance, and mean to take the whole region for themselves.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his is recorded.
